correctness.rationale: The four-dimensional moment image of the TV unit ball is compact and spans the moment space (use four distinct nodes). Separation gives attained duality over bounded real cubics, and weak-star compactness gives primal attainment. Both nonzero amplitudes force the sign interpolation p(a)=1, p(b)=−1 for optimality; interior contact also forces p′(a)=p′(b)=0. These determine a unique cubic, namely T₃((t−c)/Δ) with c=(a+b)/2 and Δ=b−a. Since |T₃|≤1 exactly on [−1,1] over the reals, the test is Δ≥max(1+c,1−c). Failure implies a strictly lower attained TV, not just a second minimizer. At a feasible pair the saturation set has at most four nodes, the two interior sites and possibly one or both endpoints. Any minimizer is supported on these nodes; four monomial moments are injective there by Vandermonde rank. For uniformly sorted sites, at center c the half-gap ranges up to 1−|c| and must be at least (1+|c|)/2. Using Jacobian 2 gives recovery area 1/3 out of ordered area 2. At |c|=1/3 there are in fact no feasible interior pairs, consistent with the stated exclusion for |c|>1/3. These checks are exact; the source checker was inspected, not run, and grid diagnostics are not needed for the result.

evidence: De Castro–Gamboa give sign interpolation, strict off-support boundedness and generalized Vandermonde rank as sufficient for uniqueness. Bendory–Dekel–Feuer give a high-degree sufficient separation theorem under N≥128 and a bounded-certificate criterion with strict off-support control.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These results provide proof machinery, not a necessary separation criterion in degree three. Strict off-support control fails at the endpoint-contact frontier; uniqueness there requires reasoning on the enlarged saturation set. The high-degree theorem cannot be applied at degree three.

evidence: The classical dual form supplies an optimization criterion over bounded polynomials, but does not determine the unique interpolating cubic for variable sites and its boundary behavior. The latter requires interior Hermite interpolation, endpoint feasibility, and a separate optimal-support uniqueness argument.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A general framework and a symmetric witness do not give the sharp two-parameter if-and-only-if statement or its strict complement as an existing theorem's specialization. The area is elementary once the location region is known, and is not a separate originality claim.

value.rationale: At the four-moment budget, exact invertibility of a sparse model and success of unrestricted TV minimization are genuinely different questions. The threshold classifies when TV succeeds, certifies strict failure everywhere else irrespective of amplitudes, and settles the equality case that strict-certificate theorems cannot cover. This is useful as a sharp benchmark for low-degree recovery; the probability is a consequence, not the reason for acceptance.
